params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry this reads; its point attributes are created, changed or deleted and the result passed on.

params.name: operation
params.label: Operation
params.description: What is done to the named point attribute: create it, delete it, remap or clip its range, normalize it, combine it with any number of operands (set it, add to it, scale it, …), or promote it between point and detail.

params.name: attribute_name
params.label: Name
params.description: The point attribute to work on. Pos and Col are the built-in position and colour; they can be combined but not created or deleted.

params.name: type
params.label: Type
params.description: How many components the new attribute has: one number, or a vector of two, three or four.

params.name: value_from
params.label: Value From
params.description: Where the value comes from: Constant uses the Value row for every point; Attribute reads each point's own value of From Attribute.

params.name: from_attribute
params.label: From Attribute
params.description: The point attribute each point's value is read from when Value From is Attribute: copied as it is when it is as wide as the result, a single number spread to every component, otherwise as many components as fit, the rest zero. Pos and Col name the position and the colour.

params.name: value
params.label: Value
params.description: The number or numbers written, separated by spaces, commas or colons. One number fills every component; otherwise the count must match the attribute's width.

params.name: combine_op
params.label: Combine
params.description: How the operands meet Name, componentwise and left to right: ((Name op 1) op 2) and on. Set replaces Name with the last operand; Average is the mean of Name and every operand. Difference, Dot and Distance take one operand; Length is the length of Name and takes none. Dot, Distance and Length produce one number, written into every component.

params.name: operand_1
params.label: Operand 1
params.description: What Name is combined with: a point attribute's name, read point by point, or a constant, one number for every component or as many as Name has. Pos and Col name the position and the colour. Empty leaves it out.

params.name: add_operand
params.label: Add Operand
params.description: Adds an operand row under the last, folded in after it. A row is taken away from its right-click menu.

params.name: result
params.label: Result
params.description: The point attribute the result is written to, created when it does not exist: as wide as the widest operand, or one number for Dot, Distance and Length; points outside Group get zero. An existing attribute keeps its type; Pos and Col are the position and the colour. Empty writes the result back into Name.

params.name: strength
params.label: Strength
params.description: How much of the change lands: 1 is the full change, 0 none, 2 twice as much. Scales the difference the node makes to what it writes, under every operation.

params.name: scale_by
params.label: Scale By
params.description: A point attribute whose value weights the change per point, multiplied with Strength. Empty weights every point equally; a name that is not an attribute is an error.

params.name: per_frame
params.label: Per Frame
params.description: Inside a simulation, makes Add and Subtract a rate per frame and Multiply and Divide a factor per frame, so the substep count does not change how far a frame moves. Off lands the full amount every substep.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: A point group limiting which points are changed or measured. Empty means every point.

params.name: from_range
params.label: From Range
params.description: Where Remap's input range comes from: Manual uses the From row; Auto measures the input's lowest and highest value (over every component of the points in Group) each time the node evaluates, so the range follows the input as it changes.

params.name: detect_range
params.label: Detect Range
params.description: Measures the input's lowest and highest value once, at the current frame, and writes them into From. From then stays as written when the input changes; Auto is the range that follows.

params.name: from
params.label: From
params.show_when: operation == Clip || operation == Remap && from_range == Manual
params.description: Remap: the input range, its first value mapping to To's first and its second to To's second; the two must differ. Clip: the bounds values are clamped to.

params.name: to
params.label: To
params.description: The output range From maps onto; values between map linearly, and values outside From extend past it.

params.name: normalize_to
params.label: Normalize To
params.description: The value the chosen measure (sum, maximum or range) is scaled to hit.

params.name: to_class
params.label: To Class
params.description: Where the attribute is moved: Detail reduces the per-point values to one number for the whole geometry; Point copies a detail value onto every point.

params.name: method
params.label: Method
params.description: How point values are reduced to one detail value when promoting to Detail: their average, sum, minimum, maximum or the first point's.

params.name: target
params.label: Target
params.description: What is measured before scaling: the values' sum, their maximum, or their range (max minus min). Every value is scaled so this measure equals Normalize To.

params.name: kind
params.label: Kind
params.description: Live keeps the attribute's values from one simulation step to the next; Derivative zeroes it at the start of every step, for values the chain rebuilds each step.
